# T-3: Add file retry

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Retry only the target file whose docs.text batch parsing failed, allowing a later valid JSON response to complete the build.

## Acceptance Criteria
- First natural-language response and second valid JSON response for the same file succeeds.
- Retry count is bounded and does not create an unbounded loop.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing agent retry configuration or an explicit small file-level retry bound. Keep successful files from being reported as failed when another file retries.

## Test Strategy
Unit or integration-style test with a stub agent returning invalid then valid output for one target file.
